blurb: Guests can rent paddleboards, kayaks, and canoes for self-guided paddling on several reservoirs. They offer beginner lessons, SUP yoga, and themed paddle events like Paddles & Pints and Full Moon Paddle. Locations include Union Reservoir and others with park entry fees and facilities nearby.
extraNote: 24 hour cancellation policy with self rebooking · Weather cancellations allow rescheduling or rainchecks; park fees may not be refundable · Walk-in rentals incur 10% weekday and 20% weekend rate increase · Blue building across the grass picnic area at Union Reservoir main gate
